capabilities: jump to a typed line:column position
jump using clipboard contents as position
copy primary cursor line and column to clipboard
copy all cursor positions to clipboard
intentEvidence: This Plugin adds new Commands to go to specific Lines and Characters in Obsidian.
motivation: Created by request of a user (@arvn) on Discord.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in command to navigate the editor to an exact line and character position.
summary: Command-based plugin that jumps the cursor to a specific line and column, optionally using clipboard contents.
